investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a moderate risk score of 0.52 via the real-time ML model, which is below the threshold typically associated with high-confidence fraud alerts in historical precedents (where scores >0.80 were cleared as benign). The graph neighborhood analysis reveals no multi-hop linked cards and only a single shared device count, failing to meet the criteria for Typology B (Distributed Device Ring) which requires a device linked to at least 3 distinct accounts. Additionally, there is no evidence of geo-velocity anomalies or impossible travel to trigger Typology E. Given the low graph connectivity and the moderate risk score consistent with previously cleared benign cases, the transaction appears to be a false positive.
